description: Consume messages from Kafka topics with authentication

datasource_selector.info: Select a Kafka datasource (required, supports both custom and public datasources)

auto_offset_reset.info: Strategy when no initial offset is available

reset_offsets.info: Force reset consumer offsets to beginning of topics. Useful for re-reading all messages.

output_format.info: Message output format: flattened (single level) or raw (preserves structure)

field_extraction_mode.info: Method for extracting fields from messages

message_schema.info: Define field structure for Kafka messages

debug_mode.info: Enable detailed logging for troubleshooting message consumption issues

force_new_group.info: Create a unique consumer group ID for each execution to avoid offset conflicts

continuous_poll.info: Continuously poll for messages until timeout. Collects all messages and returns them as a list (compatible with all downstream components).

keep_consumer_alive.info: Keep the Kafka consumer connection alive between executions for real-time continuous monitoring. When enabled, the consumer will not close after each execution, allowing you to receive new messages on subsequent runs.

stream_timeout_minutes.info: Maximum duration for streaming mode. The stream will automatically stop after this period.

batch_size.info: Number of messages to process before updating status

status.no_messages_found: Connected but no messages found. Try sending messages or using 'Reset Offsets' option.

logs.schema_mode_no_schema: Schema mode enabled but no schema defined, using raw message

sample_data.info: Sample messages for field discovery (use 'Load Available Fields' in downstream components)

connection_test.info: Test Kafka connection and get diagnostic information
